name: EPIC 206313684
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 12.9 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,117 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.93 solar masses and 12.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,494 K at its surface.
